title: Secure Messaging in practice
intro: Work data belongs in approved channels. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Samir Babayev · internal work chat
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or risky?

artifact.name: Samir Babayev · internal work chat
body: I uploaded the final report to the internal system, please look there.

decisions.explain: The file itself is not sent, it stays in the internal system. That is the right way.

decisions.title: Message from Department chat · 214 members
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or risky?

artifact.name: Department chat · 214 members
body: Remote access password: Baki2026! Everyone use it.

decisions.explain: A shared password posted in a large group. Lose one phone and access opens for everyone.

decisions.title: Message from Accounts Office
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or risky?

artifact.name: Accounts Office
body: To check your salary, send photos of both sides of your ID card.

decisions.explain: The accounts office already has your details. An ID photo is used to open fake accounts.

decisions.title: Message from Meeting group
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or risky?
decisions.explain: Nothing sensitive, just a reminder. Keep documents and figures in the approved channel.
